about.title: About Catequese Viva
about.intro: A complete pastoral platform for Christian initiation, connecting dioceses, parishes, catechists, families, and catechumens in an integrated faith journey.
about.mission_text: To facilitate and strengthen the catechetical mission of the Catholic Church, offering modern tools that enable coordinators, catechists, and families to accompany Christian formation with excellence, simplicity, and security.

offers.classes: Class and catechist management — organize classes by stage, catechetical year, and community.
offers.attendance: Attendance tracking — record presence, absences, and justifications with ease.
offers.sacraments: Sacramental accompaniment — configure personalized sacramental journeys.
offers.content: Content library — create, review, and publish meeting plans.
offers.communication: Pastoral communication — send segmented messages to families and catechists.
offers.reports: Reports and indicators — track catechesis health with KPIs.

audience: Catechists who want to prepare meetings and take attendance without paper or scattered spreadsheets.
Parish coordinators who need to see every class, catechist and sacrament in one place.
Dioceses that follow several parishes, with each parish looking after its own data.
principles: Faithful to the Church: content and journeys built on the Directory for Catechesis and the path of Christian initiation.
Care for minors: children's and teenagers' data handled with guardian consent and restricted access, in line with the LGPD.
Simplicity: volunteer catechists should sort out their week in a few minutes, on their phone too.
The parish owns its data: export it whenever you like, with no lock-in.
about.contact_text: Have suggestions, want to present Catequese Viva to your parish or diocese, or found a problem? Write to the team.

faq.q: How can I try the platform before subscribing?
faq.a: You try it for 7 days, no card required. Use it with your real class; if it makes sense to continue, subscribe before the trial ends.
The Catechist Plan costs R$ 9.90/month (or R$ 99/year) and covers up to 3 classes and 150 catechumens in total — more than enough for your reality.
You start with a 7-day trial, no card required. When you subscribe, payment is handled by Stripe. No lock-in — cancel anytime.
Annual plans have no automatic refund. Cancellation stops renewal, but access continues until the paid period ends. Proportional refunds are evaluated case by case via contato@catechis.app.

The Catechist Plan covers up to 3 classes and 150 catechumens. If you need a team and more classes, organize as a parish (Parish Plan). If the diocese takes over, talk to sales — the diocese license covers the parishes. Your data and class history are preserved.
Yes. We follow LGPD with encryption in transit and at rest. Children's data receives special protection.

help.title: Help
help.intro: Quick answers to the most common questions about Catequese Viva. Didn't find what you need? Contact the team at the bottom of the page.
help.contact_text: Write to the team through the Contact page. If you already have an account, you can also use the Support center in your profile menu.

items.a: Create your account with email and password (or Google), confirm your email and follow the first steps: choose how you'll use it (catechist or parish) and create your first class.

items.q: Do I need a card to try it?
items.a: No. The 7-day free trial of the Catechist plan starts without a card. You are only asked for a card when you decide to subscribe.

items.q: What happens when the trial ends?
items.a: Your data stays saved. To keep taking attendance and using class tools, choose a plan on the Subscription page. The Bible, Catechism, Settings and Support center stay open.

items.q: How do I change my card or cancel?
items.a: In your profile menu, open Subscription and use the manage payment button. There you can change the card, see invoices or cancel, with no fee.

items.q: How do I create a class?
items.a: In Classes, tap Create class, enter the name, stage and meeting day and time. Then add the catechumens.
Open the class and tap Attendance. If there is no meeting for today yet, create it on the same screen and mark each catechumen present, absent or excused.

items.q: Can I generate the whole year's meetings at once?
items.a: Yes. In the class planning, generate weekly meetings from the class day and time. They show up in the Calendar.

items.q: Does it work on my phone?
items.a: Yes. It runs in your phone's browser. If you like, add a shortcut to your home screen to open it faster.

items.q: How do I register a catechumen?
items.a: In Catechumens, tap Register and fill in the name, date of birth and family. Then enroll them in a class from their record or from the class itself.
Yes. On the catechumen's record, invite the guardian to the family portal. They see notices, attendance, documents and consents.

items.q: Can I import a list I already have?
items.a: Yes. In Catechumens, use Import to upload a spreadsheet with names and dates of birth.
Yes. We follow Brazil's LGPD, including art. 14 on children's and teenagers' data: minimal collection, guardian consent and access only for those who run the class. See the Privacy Policy.

items.q: How do I export or delete my data?
items.a: You can export your data in Settings. To ask for deletion, write to privacidade@catechis.app.
